The concept of filial piety in China has been present throughout its long history and has played a significant role in shaping Chinese culture and society. Deifying Ancestors

The Shang Dynasty people believed that their ancestors continued to exist after death and had the power to intervene in the world of the living. They, therefore, deified their ancestors by sealing them as gods.
